SELECT A.*, B.path imagePath, B.normal_file_name normalFileName, B.small_file_name smallFileName, B.instagram_id instagramId, D.content reViewContent, E.shortCode shortCode, CASE WHEN C.id IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END AS liked
, ST_DistanceSphere( geo_info, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326) ) / 1000 AS distance
FROM restaurant AS A LEFT JOIN media AS B ON A.id = B.restaurant_id LEFT JOIN like_list AS C ON A.id = C.restaurant_id LEFT JOIN re_view AS D ON A.id = D.restaurant_id LEFT JOIN insta_info AS E ON A.insta_info_id = E.id WHERE 1 = 1
AND ST_DistanceSphere( geo_info, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326) ) / 1000 < 5
and A.id = #{id}
order by distance asc
